settings.title: Materials & Make
settings.content:
72% Stretch Supima cotton · 24% recycled nylon · 4% elastane. 100% food-grade silicone grip pattern on the full sole. Reinforced heel & toe.

  • Long-staple Supima for softness and durability
  • Full-sole silicone — not painted-on rubber
  • Ribbed cuff for a secure, no-slip-down fit

settings.title: Sizing & Fit
settings.content: Available in 2–3 sizes. UK 3–6 (S), UK 6–9 (M), UK 9–12 (L). Wears slightly snug out of the wash — softens after first wear.

settings.title: Care & Washing
settings.content: Machine washable, cold cycle, inside out. Tumble dry low or air dry. Do not iron the silicone sole. Lasts 80+ wears with normal care.

settings.title: Shipping & Returns
settings.content: Ships globally, 4–7 day delivery. Free shipping over ₹999. COD available across India. All sales final — quality guaranteed on every pair.
